title: Data Toolbar
summary: A compact toolbar composition for search, filters, selection-aware actions, and secondary controls above data-heavy views.

use_when: Users repeatedly search, filter, sort, or act on a dataset
Controls should remain visually associated with the data they affect
avoid_when: The page has only one unrelated action
Controls belong to separate workflows rather than one dataset

accessibility: Keep controls in logical keyboard and reading order.
Provide accessible names for search, filter, and action controls.
When selection changes available actions, announce the selection count in text.
